source: Impala Platinum Holdings audited annual financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2026, consolidated statement of profit or loss page 24
notes: Figures in South African rand, converted from Rm. Cost of Sales and Operating Expenses (other expenses) are printed lines. Operating Profit (EBIT) is gross profit plus the R11,119m reversal of impairment plus other income of R750m less other expenses, then plus the finance result and the share of profit of equity accounted entities to reach profit before tax; the panel schema has no row for the impairment reversal or other income, so gross profit less operating expenses is lower than the printed EBIT. Net Finance Costs is finance costs less finance income, so FY2026 shows a net finance income of 112m; net foreign exchange transaction losses of 1,240m are printed separately by the issuer. Net Profit is attributable to owners of the Company; profit for the year including non-controlling interests was 31,668m and 707m. FY2024 to FY2022 columns are carried from the previous secondary-feed snapshot, not from this filing.
